blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.
blocks.zh: 搜索富于文字的知识的图表需要遵循关系,同时审查文字证据. 被预先定义的图界面制约了证据代理能够访问的东西,即使他们写出代码来结合工具调用或处理被检索子图. 我们提出直接的知识图交互(DKGI),一种语言模型代理在完全节点和边缘文件上直接创建图访问工具的杠杆. 代理者会写出Python代码来跟踪关系,结合节点设置,并选择文字证据,将执行与 shell 搜索和文件检查相衔接. 这样可以让代理在返回选定文本供模型评估的同时大量处理大型节点设置. 执行反馈指导工具的创建和修订,而不断演变的工具则决定代理人接下来收集哪些证据. 在横跨三个领域的基准数据集上,无培训的DKGI在每个图表上至少比最强的公布基线多出6.7 Hit@1分,即使使用最小的吊带. 被控制的活化显示多回合编程对仅壳访问和预定义的图形工具的好处,而轨迹显示代理修改代码以扩展搜索或解决出错. 这些发现突出了允许工具创建和工具使用在图搜索过程中共同演变的价值. 我们的代码和数据可查阅https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI。

blocks.en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) store entities and typed relations ( Pan et al., 2024 ) . In text-rich KGs, also known as semi-structured knowledge bases, nodes carry additional text information such as product pages, paper abstracts, or drug descriptions ( Wu et al., 2024b ) . Requests over these graphs often combine relational and textual constraints. For example, to find “papers by co-authors of X on topic Y” , a large language model (LLM) agent must locate X, identify the other authors of X’s papers, collect their papers, and check which ones address Y. The challenge is therefore to connect evidence across records while inspecting the text that supports each candidate.
blocks.zh: 知识图(KGs)存储实体和打字关系(Pan等,2024.) . 在富于文本的KGs中,也被称为半结构的知识库,节点会携带产品页,纸质摘要等额外的文本信息,或者药物描述(Wu等,2024b. 对这些图表的要求往往将关系限制和文字限制结合起来。 例如,要找到“X共同作者关于专题Y的论文”,一个大型语言模型(LLM)代理商必须找到X,确定QQ论文的其他作者,收集他们的论文,并检查哪些论文涉及Y。 因此,挑战在于在检查支持每个候选人的案文的同时,将各种记录的证据联系起来。

blocks.en:
Existing methods typically access the graph through specialized interfaces. These interfaces include database query languages ( Li et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024a ) , retrievers that return reasoning paths or subgraphs ( Luo et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2024 ) , and tools for entity search, node lookup, and neighbor expansion ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . Beyond direct tool use, some agents write code that combines predefined graph tool calls ( Wu et al., 2024a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , while others generate code to traverse and process graph objects provided by a dedicated subgraph retriever ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 contrasts direct tool use (Setting ①) with these forms of code-based interaction (Setting ②). Across these designs, agents have different degrees of freedom to compute over the available data. Nevertheless, access to the underlying graph remains governed by a predefined interface .
Such interfaces determine how much evidence each operation exposes and how the agent can inspect it. Figure 1 (a) illustrates this on a request for “ papers on data quality enhancement algorithms affiliated with the University of the Balearic Islands ”. A neighbors call returns only some of the institution’s affiliated researchers. The agent must choose which researchers’ papers to examine and make calls to check whether those papers satisfy the topic constraint. In the illustrated run, it never encounters the gold paper. Writing code to batch these calls can simplify this process, but each call still inherits the API’s limits on the evidence it returns.
blocks.zh:
现有方法一般通过专门的接口访问图表. 这些接口包括数据库查询语言(Li等,2023;Gu等,2023;Luo等,2024a),返回推理路径或子图的检索器(Luo等,2024b; He et al., 2024),以及实体搜索,节点搜索,和邻居扩张的工具(Sun et al.,2024;Jin等,2024;Polonuer等,2026.). 除了直接工具使用外,有的代理编写代码结合了预定义的图形工具调用(Wu等,2024a;Jiang等,2025),而有的代理则生成代码来通过并处理由专用子图检索器提供的图形对象(Ding等,2026). 表1对比了直接工具的使用(Setting 1)与这些基于代码的交互形式(Setting 2). 在这些设计中,代理人对可用数据有不同程度的自由计算. 尽管如此,对基本图表的访问仍受预先定义的接口制约。
这种接口决定了每次行动暴露出多少证据,以及代理人如何检查. 图1(a)在“巴利阿里群岛大学附属数据质量增强算法论文”的请求中说明了这一点。 邻居只给该机构的一些附属研究人员打电话。 代理人必须选择哪些研究人员的论文来审查,并打电话检查这些论文是否符合专题限制。 在图画跑道中,它从未遇到金相纸. 写入代码来分批这些调用可以简化这个过程,但每个调用仍然继承API对它返回的证据的限制.

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which agents write and revise their own code to access text-rich KGs. Inspired by the idea of direct corpus interaction over text corpora ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we expose both textual node records and typed graph relations as files, together with the graph schema. Unlike Setting ② in Table 1 , where code uses graph query languages or APIs, or operates on retrieved subgraphs, DKGI lets the agent implement graph access directly over the complete node and edge files . The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine sets of nodes, and inspect textual attributes. It freely interleaves code execution with shell search and record inspection, refining its code as new evidence becomes available. We provide the graph files, their format description, and an execution environment. The agent constructs the graph access tools that each request needs (Setting ③ in Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出直接的知识图交互(DKGI),一种由代理编写和修改自身代码以访问丰富文本的KGs的活套. 受文字上Corpora(Li等,2026年)的直接实体交互思想的启发,我们既将文字节点记录,又将打入的图表关系作为文件,再加上图表计划. 与表1中的设置2不同,代码使用图表查询语言或API,或运行在被检索子图上,DKGI让代理直接在完整节点和边缘文件上执行图形访问. 代理员会写出Python代码来跟随关系,结合各套节点,并检查文本属性. 它可以自由地将密码执行与外壳搜查和记录检查相衔接,随着新证据的出现而完善其密码. 我们提供了图表文件、其格式描述以及执行环境。 代理构建每个请求需要的图访问工具(表1中的3).

blocks.en: On the same request, DKGI writes and revises graph access code ( tool creation ) and executes it to gather evidence ( tool use ). Execution feedback guides which access operations to create or refine. The resulting code, in turn, changes how the agent explores the graph and what evidence it obtains. Tool creation and tool use thus co-evolve : the agent develops its tools as it searches, and its evolving tools guide the subsequent search (Figure 1 (b)).
blocks.zh: 在同一请求中, DKGI 写并修改了图表访问码( 工具创建 )并执行以收集证据( 工具使用 ) . 执行反馈指南,用于创建或完善操作。 由此产生的代码反过来又会改变代理人对图的探索方式及其获得的证据. 因此,工具创建和工具使用是共同演变的:代理在搜索时开发工具,其不断发展的工具指导随后的搜索(图1(b))。

blocks.en:
We evaluate DKGI as a training-free method on the three KGs (Amazon, MAG, and Prime) from the STaRK benchmark ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , using both the minimal Pi harness ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) and the more feature-rich Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Even in Pi, our best DKGI configuration exceeds the strongest published baseline ( Tao et al., 2026 ) by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every dataset. Controlled ablations examine the role of agent-written graph access code. With the backbone, harness, and budgets held fixed, shell-only access trails predefined graph tools, whereas allowing the agent to write and execute Python code improves overall Hit@1 by 6.9 points and reverses this comparison.
A single Python execution recovers little of this gain, supporting the value of multi-turn interaction. Analysis of trajectories further shows that agents use execution feedback to create and refine graph access code, which in turn guides further search. Tool creation and tool use thus co-evolve during graph search.
blocks.zh:
我们从STARK基准(Wu等人,2024年b)中评价DKGI是三种KG(Amazon、MAG和Prime)的无培训方法, 即使在Pi中,我们最好的DKGI配置也超过了每个数据集上最强的已公布基线(Tao等,2026年)至少6.7 Hit@1分. 被控制的活化检查了代理-书面图表访问码的作用. 使用主干线,用管,和预算持有固定的,只使用 shell 的访问线索预设了图形工具,而允许代理编写和执行 Python 代码则将整体Hit@1改进了6.9分并反转了这一比较.
单 Python 执行能收回这一收益很少,支持多回合互动的价值. 对轨迹的分析还进一步表明,代理商利用执行反馈来创建并完善图表访问码,进而指导进一步搜索. 工具创建和工具使用因此在图搜索中共同进行.

blocks.en: To summarize, our contributions are: • We introduce DKGI, a harness in which agents create and refine graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. • We show that training-free DKGI achieves state-of-the-art performance on the STaRK benchmark using a minimal agent harness. • Controlled ablations and trajectory analyses show the benefits of interleaving tool creation and tool use and characterize how the two co-evolve during agent–KG interactions.
blocks.zh: 概括地说,我们的贡献是: 我们引入了 DKGI, 一种工具, 由代理直接在完整的节点和边缘文件上创建和完善图形访问工具 。 我们显示,免费培训的DKGI在STARK基准上实现了最先进的性能,使用一个最小的代理机管. · 控制下编组和轨迹分析显示互换工具的创造和使用的好处,并描述两种工具在代理人-KG相互作用期间的共同演变情况。

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview and Notation
blocks.zh: 2.1 概述和标记

blocks.en: DKGI places complete graph files in an agent harness. The harness provides an execution environment and returns observations, while the agent determines how to acquire and combine the evidence needed for each request (Figure 1 ).

Given a query q q that may combine relational and textual constraints, the agent returns candidate nodes ranked by their relevance to q q . blocks.en: The file layout supports both text search and code execution. Text search locates nodes by matching their attributes, while Python can extract the fields needed for further reasoning. A format description specifies the file locations and how to locate nodes by ID. Edge endpoints let code follow a relation in either direction, with the schema guiding interpretation of entity roles. The agent is directed to inspect the format description and schema at the start of a task, then decides which nodes, relations, and attributes to inspect. Appendix A documents the concrete export layout used in our experiments.

blocks.en:
Broad searches and graph traversals can produce outputs that exceed the model’s context budget. Output handling therefore affects both the current observation and the evidence available for later actions ( Sen et al., 2026 ) . Following the use of output files in Pi ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) and DR-DCI ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , our Pi implementation saves the complete output y t = run ⁡ ( a t ) y_{t}=\mathrm{run}(a_{t}) of every shell command as a file ℓ t \ell_{t} in the task’s scratch directory. It presents the model with view ⁡ ( y t ) = { y t , | y t | ≤ B , head ⁡ ( y t ) | n t | tail ⁡ ( y t ) , | y t | > B , \mathrm{view}(y_{t})=\begin{cases}y_{t},&|y_{t}|\leq B,\\
\mathrm{head}(y_{t})\|n_{t}\|\mathrm{tail}(y_{t}),&|y_{t}|>B,\end{cases} where B B is the display threshold, head ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{head}(\cdot) and tail ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{tail}(\cdot) return the beginning and end of y t y_{t} , and the notice n t n_{t} gives its full size and the path ℓ t \ell_{t} . This head-and-tail truncation bounds what enters the model’s context while retaining the complete execution result. Later code can search or filter ℓ t \ell_{t} , recover IDs omitted from the displayed excerpt, or combine its contents with other evidence. Access code can also return compact candidate lists or selected text fields, giving the agent control over the evidence presented in subsequent observations. Thus an output of tool use can become an input to subsequent tool creation. Appendix C specifies the thresholds and notice, while § 2.6 describes the differences between harnesses.

blocks.en: 2.5 Co-Evolving Toolbox
blocks.zh: 2.5 共同演变工具箱

blocks.en: Execution provides candidate IDs, intermediate sets, empty matches, and error messages. The agent can use these observations in later turns to choose another traversal, narrow a filter, inspect a file’s structure, or revise earlier code. The revised code determines which nodes and relations subsequent executions examine. Tool creation and tool use therefore co-evolve : evidence guides the construction of access procedures, and those procedures guide further evidence gathering.
blocks.zh: 执行提供候选ID,中间集,空匹配,以及出错消息. 代理可以使用这些观察在后回转中选择另一个倒转,缩小过滤器,检查文件的结构,或者修改更早的代码. 修订后的法典决定了哪些节点以及随后的处决审查之间的关系。 因此,工具的创建和工具的使用是共同演变的:证据指导进入程序的构建,而这些程序则指导进一步的证据收集。

blocks.en: In our Pi implementation, the toolbox 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} consists of access code retained in the interaction history for reuse and revision, while ℒ t \mathcal{L}_{t} denotes the saved shell-output files. When an action executes code p t p_{t} and saves an output ℓ t \ell_{t} , these sets become 𝒯 t + 1 = 𝒯 t ∪ { p t } , ℒ t + 1 = ℒ t ∪ { ℓ t } . \mathcal{T}_{t+1}=\mathcal{T}_{t}\cup\{p_{t}\},\qquad\mathcal{L}_{t+1}=\mathcal{L}_{t}\cup\{\ell_{t}\}. For actions that contribute no access code or no saved output, the corresponding set is unchanged. Subsequent code can reuse snippets from 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} , read files in ℒ t \mathcal{L}_{t} , and incorporate IDs from earlier observations. It can revise a failed computation or extend an earlier traversal with new constraints. The agent can also return to shell search or file inspection whenever it needs more evidence. This process develops the access code within a task, without model training or a tool library learned across tasks. Section 3.4 examines these behaviors, with the measurement rules in Appendix G .

blocks.en: 2.6 Implementation
blocks.zh: 2.6 执行情况

blocks.en: We instantiate DKGI in two general-purpose harnesses: the minimal Pi ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) and the more feature-rich Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Pi provides a simple setting for controlled ablations of graph access and agent-written code, with the model, harness, and budgets held fixed (§ 3.3 ). Codex tests the same design with richer runtime support. Both provide read-only graph files, a format description, a schema, and a writable scratch directory. Following Li et al. (2026) , the Pi implementation supplements its bash and read tools with lightweight context management that retains code while replacing older tool results with placeholders as the context fills. We add the graph export, task prompt, output handling of § 2.4 , and an execution sandbox. In Codex, the model invokes shell commands, including Python, through JavaScript, with Codex’s own output and context management. Appendices B.1 and C document the prompts and implementation settings.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种通用的用具将DKGI即时化:最小的Pi(Zechner和Pi Controductioners,2026年)和功能更丰富的Codex CLI(OpenAI,2026a年). Pi提供了一个简单的设置,用于控制图取用和代理书写代码的拼接,模型、用具和预算固定(第3.3节)。 以更丰富的运行时间支持来测试同一种设计. 两者都提供了只读的图文件,格式描述,图案计划,以及可书写的抓取目录. 继Li等 (2026)后, Pi 执行用轻量级上下文管理来补充其bash和读取工具,保留了代码,同时在上下文填充时用占位符来取代更旧的工具结果. 我们添加图导出,任务提示, 输出处理§ 2.4, 和一个执行沙盒。 在Codex中,该模型通过JavaScript引用包括Python在内的 shell命令,并带有Codex自己的输出和上下文管理. 附录B.1和C记录提示和执行设置。

blocks.en: Data. We use the full synthetic test sets of the STaRK benchmark ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , with 1,642, 2,665 and 2,801 queries for the Amazon, MAG and Prime domains, respectively (7,108 in total). We make all prompt and tool design decisions on validation queries and reserve test labels for evaluation. The ablations use the official 10% test subset (164, 266 and 280 queries, 710 in total).

blocks.en: Models and limits. The default backbone is the lightweight GPT-6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , and the stronger GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) is the second backbone, both with high reasoning effort. Each attempt has at most 1,800 s of wall-clock time, and each Pi attempt at most 300 turns.

blocks.en: Metrics. Following STaRK, we report Hit@1 (H@1, also called Hits@1), Recall@20 (R@20) and mean reciprocal rank (MRR). Because the agent is asked for 20 IDs, our MRR is a lower bound on the full-ranking MRR. A query whose attempts all fail counts as a miss in every metric (retry policy in Appendix C ). Overall values are micro-averages over all queries of the three datasets, and differences are computed before rounding. Appendix C reports the cost and resource use of each configuration.

blocks.en: Baselines. We report published results and, as in Table 2 , separate the systems trained or tuned on STaRK from the training-free ones. The baselines are retrievers, LLM pipelines and agents, and all of them access the KG through predefined operations. The strongest trained system, GRASP ( Tao et al., 2026 ) , combines a Cypher query on a graph database with a trained dense retriever and a fine-tuned reranker. Among the training-free systems, KAR ( Xia et al., 2025b ) and AF-Retriever ( Boer et al., 2026 ) are LLM pipelines. KAR expands the query from the documents of neighboring entities, and AF-Retriever translates it into graph constraints. The agent ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) calls predefined global search and one-hop neighborhood search tools. We list separately three KG reasoning methods (ToG, RoG and GoG) that Yang et al. (2025) adapt to STaRK and run with GPT-4. Appendix E describes every system.

blocks.en: With GPT-6-Luna, DKGI is the strongest training-free method on MAG and Prime, and with GPT-6-Astra it achieves the highest H@1 and MRR on every dataset (Table 2 ). On MAG and Prime, DKGI with GPT-6-Luna in Pi outperforms every training-free baseline in all three metrics and exceeds the best of them in H@1 by 9.4 points on MAG (AF-Retriever) and by 13.2 points on Prime (ARK). On every dataset, it also outperforms the three KG reasoning methods that Yang et al. (2025) adapt to STaRK, whose H@1 is at most 41.3.

blocks.en: As a training-free method, DKGI also outperforms the strongest trained system, GRASP, in H@1 and MRR, on MAG with GPT-6-Luna and on all three datasets with GPT-6-Astra. With GPT-6-Luna in Pi, its margins on MAG are 5.2 H@1 and 1.5 MRR points. With GPT-6-Astra in Pi, its H@1 margins over GRASP are 8.2, 9.0 and 6.7 points on Amazon, MAG and Prime, respectively. With the same prompt and harness, overall H@1 rises from 71.5 with GPT-6-Luna to 82.1 with GPT-6-Astra.
blocks.zh: 作为一种无培训方法,DKGI在H@1和MRR、MAG与GPT-6-Luna以及GPT-6-Astra的所有三个数据集上也都超过了训练最强的系统GRASP。 GPT-6-Luna位于Pi,其在MAG上的边距为5.2 H@1和1.5 MCR点. 与Pi的GPT-6-Astra相比,其H@1相较于巨猿生存方案,在亚马逊、MAG和Prime上分别为8.2分、9.0分和6.7分。 在同样迅速的利用下,总体H@1从GPT-6-Luna的71.5上升到了GPT-6-Astra的82.1.

blocks.en: The results carry over to a second agent harness. In Codex, with the same backbone (GPT-6-Luna), prompt and time limit, DKGI reaches an overall H@1 of 73.1 on the full test sets, compared with 71.5 in Pi (Table 2 ). Appendix D gives the comparison on the test subset.
blocks.zh: 检测结果会转移到第二层 在Codex中,同干线(GPT-6-Luna),即时而有时间限制,DKGI在全测试集上达到总体H@1为73.1,而皮(表2.)则为71.5. 附 录 D给出了测试子集的比较.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Section 3.2 compares DKGI with published systems that differ from it in model, training and graph access. To identify which components of DKGI account for its accuracy, we fix the model (GPT-6-Luna), the harness (Pi), the budgets and the prompt apart from its tool section (Appendices B.1 and C ), and vary which actions a t a_{t} (§ 2 ) the agent can take. All variants run on the test subset (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 第3.2节将DKGI与公布的系统进行比较,这些系统在模型,培训和图表访问上都与其不同. 为了确定DKGI的哪些组成部分的准确性,我们除了其工具部分(附录B.1和C)外,还固定了模型(GPT-6-Luna),牵引装置(Pi),预算和快件,并更改了代理商可以采取的t a_{t}(§2)的动作. 所有变体运行在测试子集上(表3).

blocks.en: The 2 × 2 2\times 2 design crosses graph access with Python. With predefined graph tools. The agent has four graph tools based on ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . search ranks nodes by BM25 over their names and summaries, get_node returns the record of an ID, get_schema returns the schema, and neighbors returns at most 20 one-hop neighbors of a node, with optional relation, type and keyword filters. In Graph tools, each graph access is a single call to one of these tools, as in ARK, Graph-CoT and ToG ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . In Graph tools + code, the agent writes and revises Python programs that reach the graph through client calls to the four tools. AvaTaR and KG-Agent also compose predefined tool calls in code ( Wu et al., 2024a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . With the graph files. Full DKGI has the graph files, a shell and Python. In Shell only, the agent combines Pi’s read tool and shell commands such as rg , sed and sort with bash pipelines, loops and arithmetic, while python3 , awk , perl and node are blocked. One program restricts Full DKGI to the shell commands of Shell only and a single Python run per query, so the agent writes all of its Python operations before it sees the output of any of them. Control variants. Retrieval only removes neighbors from Graph tools, and No edges removes the edge files from Full DKGI. In the closed-book probes (Appendix F ), the model answers once from its own knowledge, with STaRK node IDs (the ID probe ) or, on MAG and Prime, with entity names mapped to IDs offline (the name probe ).
blocks.zh: 2×2 2\times 2设计与Python交叉图访问. 带有预定义的图形工具. 该剂有四个基于ARK的图工具(Polonuer等,2026. 搜索通过 BM25 在名称和摘要上排列节点, get_node 返回一个ID的记录, get_schema 返回chema,邻接者返回一个节点的最多20个一跳相邻,并带有可选的关系,类型和关键字过滤器. 在Graph工具中,每个Graph访问都是对其中一个工具的单一调用,如ARK、Graph-CoT和ToG(Polonuer等,2026;Jin等,2024;Sun等,2024)。 在Graph工具+代码中,代理编写并修改了Python程序,通过客户端调用到四个工具来到达图. AvaTAR和KG-Agent还用代码编写预先定义的工具调用(Wu等,2024a; 蒋等, 2025. ). 与图文件. Full DKGI拥有图文件,外壳和Python. 仅在壳牌中,代理将Pi的读取工具和 shell 命令,如 rg, sed 和排序与 bash 管道, 循环和算术, 而python3 , awk, perl和节点则被屏蔽. 一个程序将 Full DKGI 限制在 Shell 的 shell 命令中,并且每个查询有一个单 Python 运行,所以代理在看到其中任何一个输出之前会写入其所有的 Python 操作. 控制变种. 检索只从 Graph 工具中去除邻居,没有边缘从 Full DKGI 中去除边缘文件. 在闭页探测器(Appendix F)中,模型自知一次回答,有STARK节点ID(ID探测器),或者在MAG和Prime上,实体名称被映射到ID离线(名称探测器).

blocks.en: Figure 2: Behavior of Full DKGI (Pi, GPT-6-Luna) on the full test sets. (a) Python commands, rg searches and other calls (mostly read ) by position in the trajectory. (b) Programs by operation type (types overlap). The blue types have counterparts among predefined graph tools. (c) Error types of incorrectly answered queries (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 图2:在全测试集上完全DKGI(Pi,GPT-6-Luna)的行为. (a) Python命令、rg搜索和其他电话(大多数读取),按轨迹中的位置排列。 (b) 按业务类型分列的方案(类型重叠)。 蓝色类型在预定义的图表工具中有对应的. (c) 错误回答的查询类型(附录H.)。

blocks.en: With Python, the agent outperforms predefined graph tools in overall H@1. With the shell but no Python (Shell only), the agent scores 68.3 overall H@1, below Graph tools (72.8), and it is also lower on every dataset and in overall R@20 and MRR. It prints entire records (an Amazon product record includes all of its reviews) and follows relations by searching the edge files with rg . With Python, Full DKGI reaches 75.2, 2.4 points above Graph tools, and its MRR is also higher (78.9 vs. 77.6). The lead comes from MAG and Prime.
blocks.zh: 用 Python , 代理在整体 H@ 1 中比预定义的图形工具要好 。 由于外壳上没有Python(只有壳牌),代理商在Graph工具下方(72.8)的分数为68.3总的H@1分,而且在每个数据集以及总体R@20和MRR中也较低. 它会打印出整个记录(一个亚马逊产品记录包括它的所有评论),并通过用rg搜索边缘文件来跟踪关系. 有了Python,Full DKGI在Graph工具上达到75.2分,2.4分,其MRR也更高(78.9对77.6). 领先来自MAG和Prime.

blocks.en: Python improves the agent far more than it improves predefined graph tools. On the graph files, adding Python (Full DKGI vs. Shell only) improves overall H@1 by 6.9 points, R@20 by 8.5 and MRR by 6.9. With the graph tools, adding Python (Graph tools + code vs. Graph tools) improves overall H@1 and MRR by 1.4 points each. The tools search and neighbors already return compact entries with node IDs, names and types. On the graph files, the agent’s programs produce such entries themselves, by extracting a few fields from each node record and following relations over the edge files.
blocks.zh: Python改进了代理远大于改进了预定义的图形工具. 在图表文件上,加入Python(Full DKGI vs. Shell只)可以使整体H@1改善6.9分,R@20改善8.5分,MRRR改善6.9分. 有了图表工具,添加了Python(Graph工具+代码 vs. Graph工具),使总体H@1和MRR各提高了1.4分. 工具搜索和邻居已经返回带有节点ID,名称和类型的紧凑项. 在图文件中,代理程序通过从每个节点记录中取出几个字段并跟踪边缘文件上的关系,自行制作这样的条目.

blocks.en: The agent gains most from Python when it writes and executes programs over several turns. One program reaches 69.0 overall H@1, 0.7 points above Shell only and 6.2 below Full DKGI. A single program recovers about a tenth of the 6.9-point gain from Python on the graph files, although the agent runs its program in 81% of the queries. On the queries in which both variants run Python, this program is longer than the first program of Full DKGI (median 15 vs. 8 lines) and shorter than all programs of Full DKGI on the query together (median 41 lines). These results support the value of repeated, adaptive programming.
blocks.zh: Python 撰写和执行程序时, 代理商从中获利最多。 一个方案达到69.0总体H@1,仅比壳牌高0.7分,低于Full DKGI高6.2分. 一个单一程序从图文件中的Python的6.9分收益中回收了约十分之一,尽管代理在81%的查询中运行其程序. 在两个变体运行Python的查询中,这个程序比Full DKGI的第一个程序长(中间15对8行),也比Full DKGI在查询中一起运行的所有程序短(中间41行). 这些成果支持了重复、适应性强的方案拟订的价值。

blocks.en: Full DKGI achieves higher overall H@1 than predefined graph tools composed in code. Full DKGI is 1.0 point above Graph tools + code in overall H@1 (75.2 vs. 74.2), and the two are equal in MRR (78.9). On MAG and Prime together, its H@1 is 80.0, compared with 76.7 for Graph tools and 78.4 for Graph tools + code. Unlike both tool variants, it needs no predefined graph API and works on the exported graph files.
blocks.zh: 完整的 DKGI 实现了比由代码构成的预定义的图表工具更高的整体H@1. 完整的DKGI在总体H@1(75.2 vs 74.2)中比Graph工具+代码高出1.0分,两者在MRR(78.9)中相等. 在MAG和Prime中,其H@1为80.0,而Graph工具为76.7;Graph工具+代码为78.4。 与两个工具变体不同,它不需要预定义的图表 API,并在导出的图表文件中工作.

blocks.en: The agent relies on the relations in the graph. Removing access to the relations lowers accuracy sharply, mostly on MAG and Prime. No edges reaches 44.2 overall H@1, 31.0 points below Full DKGI, and Retrieval only reaches 47.7, 25.1 points below Graph tools. The ID probe shows little recall of benchmark IDs. On the full test sets, the ID probe answers one Prime query correctly, and the name probe answers 2.3% of MAG and 20.9% of Prime queries correctly. On the 223 test-subset Prime queries that the name probe misses, the lead of Full DKGI over Graph tools is 4.0 points (63.2 vs. 59.2), compared with 3.2 points on all Prime queries of the test subset.
blocks.zh: 代理人依靠图中的关系. 取消对关系的访问会大大地降低准确度,主要是在MAG和Prime上。 没有边缘达到44.2总的H@1,31.0分低于Full DKGI,而检索只达到47.7分,25.1分低于Graph工具. ID探测器显示,基准ID的回溯不多. 在完整的测试集中,ID探测器正确回答了一个Prime查询,而名称探测器正确回答了MAG的2.3%和Prime查询的20.9%. 在名称探测器错过的223个测试子集Prime查询上,Full DKGI在Graph工具上的领先点为4.0分(63.2对59.2),而测试子集所有Prime查询上的领先点为3.2分.

blocks.en: 3.4 How Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
blocks.zh: 3.4 工具创建和工具使用共同演变

blocks.en: Section 3.3 shows that the agent gains most from Python when it writes and executes programs over several turns. We trace this process in the 7,108 trajectories of Full DKGI with GPT-6-Luna on the full test sets (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 第3.3节显示,代理商在几个回合写和执行程序时,从Python得到的收益最大. 我们用GPT-6-Luna在7,108个全DKGI轨迹中跟踪整个测试集(图2.)中的这一过程。

blocks.en: The agent searches first and then writes programs. A trajectory starts with file reads and rg searches, and Python makes up 8.2% of the calls between 20% and 40% of a trajectory and 83.3% of the calls in its last 20% (Figure 2 a). The agent writes 4.0 programs per query on average. Of all programs, 75.0% contain a full node scan and 35.5% a one-hop traversal. In 42.3% of the queries, a program contains scoring or ranking, a multi-hop traversal or a set operation (Figure 2 b). The two operation types in blue have counterparts among the predefined graph tools, as neighbors performs a one-hop traversal and get_node looks up a node by its ID.
blocks.zh: 代理先搜索然后写程序. 轨迹从文件读取和rg搜索开始,而Python在轨迹的20%至40%和最后20%的83.3%(图2a)之间的通话中占8.2%. 代理平均每个查询写4.0程序. 在所有程序中,75.0%包含全节点扫描,35.5%包含一跳倒转. 在42.3%的查询中,一个程序包含得分或排名,多跳倒转或设置操作(图2b). 蓝色两种操作类型在预定义的图形工具中都有对应的,因为相邻者执行一跳倒转并获得_node通过它的ID向上查找一个节点.

blocks.en: Programs reuse IDs from earlier outputs and code from earlier programs. Of all programs, 48.4% contain a node ID shown in the output of an earlier turn, and almost all of these programs check the IDs (48.0% of all programs, Figure 2 b). In the request of Figure 1 , two rg searches return the IDs of the university and of the field Data quality , and the agent’s programs take these IDs as input to collect the 236 papers of the university’s 66 authors and intersect them with the 86 papers of the field. Programs also reuse the code of earlier programs. Of all programs, 36.5% revise an earlier one under our similarity criterion (Appendix G ). After a program fails, the next program revises it in 88.6% of cases, and after a program runs successfully, the next program revises it in 49.7% of cases. In this way, the agent’s tools evolve from one another within a task. One program, which allows a single program per query, removes this process and recovers a tenth of the gain from Python (§ 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 程序重用早期输出的ID和早期程序的代码. 在所有程序中,48.4%包含在较早转弯输出中显示的节点ID,几乎所有这些程序都检查了ID(占所有程序的48.0%,图2b). 在图1的要求中,两个rg搜索返回了大学的身份证和实地数据质量,代理程序将这些身份证作为投入,收集了大学66位作者的236篇论文,并与实地的86篇论文相交. 程序还重新使用早期程序的代码. 在所有方案中,36.5%根据我们的相似性标准(附录G)修改了先前的方案。 一个方案失败后,下一个方案在88.6%的案例中修改了它,一个方案成功运行后,下一个方案在49.7%的案例中修改了它. 因此,代理人的工具在一项任务中相互演变。 一个程序允许每个查询一个单一的程序,它取消了这个过程,从Python(§3.3.)中取回收益的十分之一.

blocks.en: The agent’s lead over predefined graph tools is largest on queries where both tool-based agents make many calls. On the 100 test-subset queries for which both Graph tools and Graph tools + code call neighbors at least ten times, Full DKGI leads them by 9.0 and 6.0 H@1 points, compared with 1.3 and 0.2 points on the other 610 queries. These 100 queries all come from MAG and Prime, and 85.0% of them have a program with scoring or ranking, a multi-hop traversal or a set operation, compared with 37.5% of the other queries. The request of Figure 1 is one of these 100 queries. The Graph tools agent misses its gold paper, which Full DKGI ranks first (Appendix I compares the two agents on two more requests).
blocks.zh: 代理商对预定义的图表工具的领先性在询问中最大,因为这两个基于工具的代理商都会打很多电话. 在Graph工具和Graph工具+代码调用邻居至少10次的100个测试子集查询上,Full DKGI以9.0分和6.0分H@1分领先他们,而其他610个查询则分别是1.3分和0.2分. 这100个查询都来自MAG和Prime,其中85.0%的查询有评分或排名,多跳倒转或设定操作的程序,而其他查询的37.5%. 图1的要求是这100个查询之一。 Graph 工具代理错过了它的黄金纸, Full DKGI 排名第一(附录一在另外两个请求上比较两个代理).

blocks.en: With a stronger LLM, the agent reuses earlier outputs more often and revises more of its failed programs. With GPT-6-Astra, the agent turns to programs earlier (Python makes up 31.4% of the calls between 20% and 40% of a trajectory, compared with 8.2%), 59.9% of its programs contain an ID from an earlier output (compared with 48.4%), and the next program revises a failed one in 92.2% of cases (compared with 88.6%). With GPT-6-Luna in Codex, the last two shares are 50.3% and 85.1%, close to those in Pi (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 随着LLM的更强,剂会更频繁地再用更早的输出,并修改更多失败的程序. 在GPT-6-Astra公司,代理商更早地转向程序(Python公司占一个轨道的20%至40%的通话量的31.4%,而占8.2%),59.9%的节目包含来自一个更早产出的ID(48.4%),而下一个节目则在92.2%的个案中修改了一个失败的ID(88.6%).6%. 随着GPT-6-Luna在Codex中,后两股为50.3%和85.1%,相近于Pi (Appendix G.

blocks.en: Ranking is the largest source of remaining errors. Among the queries that Full DKGI answers incorrectly, a gold node is returned but ranked below the first position in 58%, 46% and 55% on Amazon, MAG and Prime, and search misses account for 41%, 23% and 37% (Figure 2 c).
blocks.zh: 排名是剩余出错的最大来源. 在Full DKGI不正确回答的询问中,一个黄金节点被返回,但在亚马逊,MAG和Prime上以58%,46%和55%的排名低于第一位置,而搜索缺失率占了41%,23%和37%(图2 c).

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Direct tool use. Retrieve-then-reason methods ( Jiang et al., 2023b ; Luo et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ; Mavromatis and Karypis, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) retrieve reasoning paths or subgraphs from the KG and reason over them. In KG agents such as ToG ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) , the LLM steers a predefined beam search over entities and relations, and StructGPT ( Jiang et al., 2023a ) , Graph-CoT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) , GoG ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and Plan-on-Graph ( Chen et al., 2024a ) give it other sets of predefined graph functions. GRA ( Dragic et al., 2026 ) explores hybrid KGs through seven predefined Unix-style tools such as ls , cat and grep .
blocks.zh: 直接工具使用. 检索当时的推理方法(Jiang等,2023b;Luo等,2024b;Kim等,2023;He等,2024;Mavromatis和Karypis,2025;Li等,2025b)从KG取取推理路径或子图并取其理由. 在ToG(Sun等,2024;Ma等,2025)等KG代理中,LLM对实体和关系进行预先定义的光束搜索,而StructGPT(Jiang等,2023a),Graph-CoT(Jin等,2024),GoG(Xu等,2024)和Plan-on-Graph(Chen等,2024a)给出了其他预先定义的图表功能. GRA (Dragic等, 2026)通过Is, Cat和grep等7个被预先定义的Unix风格工具来探索混合KG.

blocks.en: Code over a graph interface. Semantic parsing maps a question to SPARQL, an S-expression or a program executed on the KG ( Liang et al., 2017 ; Cao et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024a ) , and Xiong et al. (2024) build these logical forms interactively through knowledge-base APIs. KG-Agent ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes a small model to generate programs that call predefined tools. Code-on-Graph ( Ding et al., 2026 ) represents the schema as Python classes and generates code that processes graph objects provided by a subgraph retriever. On STaRK, AvaTaR ( Wu et al., 2024a ) optimizes the prompt of an agent that composes predefined functions in Python.
blocks.zh: 代码通过一个图表界面。 语义解析一个问题到SPARQL,一个S-表达式或一个在KG上执行的程序(Liang等,2017;Cao等,2022;Li等,2023;Gu等,2023;Luo等,2024a),和Xiong等(2024)通过知识基础API交互构建这些逻辑形式. KG-Agent (Jiang et al., 2025) 微调出一个小模型来生成调用预定义工具的程序. Code-on-Graph (Ding等, 2026) 代表作为 Python 类的 schema 并生成处理由子图检索器提供的图形对象的代码. 在STARK上,AvaTAR(Wu等,2024a)优化了在Python中作预定义函数的代理的提示.

blocks.en: Agents that create their own tools. Outside KGs, CodeAct agents ( Wang et al., 2024a ) act through executable Python, and other methods create tools as code ( Cai et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wölflein et al., 2025 ) . CREATOR ( Qian et al., 2023 ) , Self-Debug ( Chen et al., 2024b ) and PyVision ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) refine code using execution feedback. Live-SWE-agent ( Xia et al., 2025a ) creates tools within a minimal bash scaffold to solve software issues. SMITH ( Tam et al., 2026 ) jointly trains tool creation and use with reinforcement learning and reuses tools across tasks, whereas DKGI is training-free and creates and revises tools within a task. Graph-as-Code ( Finkelshtein et al., 2026 ) iteratively writes and executes code over a table of node features, neighbor lists and labels for node classification. For entity search over typed, multi-relational KGs, DKGI is to our knowledge the first harness that lets agents implement graph operations over complete node and edge files.
blocks.zh: 创造自己工具的特工 KGs之外,CodeAct代理商(Wang等,2024a)通过可执行活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活体活 CREATOR (Qian等, 2023),自发调试 (Chen等, 2024b)和PyVision (Zhao等, 2025)利用执行反馈来完善代码. 现场特工 (Xia等,2025a.)在最小的活泼脚手架内创建工具以解决软件问题. SMITH(Tam等,2026年)联合培训工具的创建和使用,并进行强化学习和跨任务再利用工具,而DKGI是无培训的,并在任务范围内创建和修改工具. Graph-as-Code (Finkelshtein等, 2026) 迭代地在节点特征表,相邻列表和分级标签上写出并执行代码. 对于键入的,多关系 KGs 的实体搜索, DKGI 就我们所知, 是第一个让代理在完整节点和边缘文件上执行图操作的控制器 。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented DKGI, a harness where LLM agents write and execute their own graph access code over the complete node and edge files. With GPT-6-Astra, the training-free DKGI achieves the highest H@1 and MRR on every STaRK dataset. In controlled ablations with GPT-6-Luna, the agent achieves higher overall H@1 than predefined graph tools, whether called directly or composed in code, and it gains most when it writes and revises programs over several turns. Its trajectories show how tool creation and tool use co-evolve within a task.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了DKGI,一种LLM代理在完整的节点和边缘文件上书写和执行自己图形访问码的牵引. 通过GPT-6-Astra,免费培训的DKGI在每个STARK数据集上实现了最高的H@1和MRR. 在与GPT-6-Luna的受控活化中,代理实现的整体H@1高于预定义的图形工具,无论是直接调用还是由代码构成,当它写作和修改程序时,其收益最多. 它的轨迹显示工具创建和工具如何在任务范围内使用共同演化.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Scope. Our evaluation covers the three text-rich KGs of STaRK, which have at most 10 entity types, 18 relation types, 1.9M entities and 39.8M edges ( Wu et al., 2024b ) . Other KG benchmarks such as WebQSP, CWQ or GrailQA ( Yih et al., 2016 ; Talmor and Berant, 2018 ; Gu et al., 2021 ) , graphs with Freebase- or Wikidata-scale schemas, aggregation questions and the scaling of DKGI with graph size are left to future work. Where a KG is too large to scan or a question needs exact aggregation, purpose-built indexes, graph databases and query languages may be more suitable, and an agent could write its graph operations on top of them. A comparison with an agent in the same harness that queries a graph database through a query language such as Cypher or SPARQL ( Feng et al., 2025 ) is also left to future work. GraphRAFT, which fine-tunes a text-to-Cypher model, enters the comparison through its published numbers.
blocks.zh: 范围。 我们的评价涵盖了STARK的三个文本丰富的KG,它们最多有10个实体类型,18个关系类型,1.9M实体和39.8M边缘(Wu等,2024b.). 其他KG基准如WebQSP,CWQ或GrailQA(Yih等,2016;Talmor和Berant,2018;Gu等,2021),带有Freebase-或Wikidata-scale schemas的图表,集合问题和带有图表大小的DKGI的缩放留待未来工作. 如果一个KG太大,无法扫描,或者一个问题需要精确的集合,则目的构建的索引,图表数据库和查询语言可能更适合,一个代理可以在上面写出其图表操作. 通过Cypher或SPARQL(冯等,2025年)等查询语言查询图表数据库时,与同一工具中的代理人进行比较也留待未来工作处理。 GraphRAFT对文本到Cypher模型进行了微调,通过所公布的数字进入了比较.

blocks.en: Models, baselines and data. Our main results use the proprietary models GPT-6-Luna and GPT-6-Astra, which we accessed through an API in September and October 2026. Exact reproduction depends on the continued availability of these models. Open-weight models remain to be tested. We release the code under the MIT License and the exported graphs, prompts and all trajectories under CC BY 4.0. Baseline numbers are taken from the literature and were obtained with different backbones, budgets and evaluation code. The ablations in § 3.3 hold these factors fixed. Our evaluation uses STaRK’s synthetic queries, which make up most of the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 模型、基线和数据。 我们的主要结果使用专有模式GPT-6-Luna和GPT-6-Astra,我们在2026年9月和10月通过API访问这些模型. 准确的复制取决于这些模型的持续提供. 开放式型号仍有待测试。 我们发布麻省理工学院许可下的代码 以及出口的图表 提示和所有轨迹 CC BY 4.0. 基线数字取自文献,是用不同的主干、预算和评价代码获得的。 第3.3节中的浮出水面因素保持不变。 我们的评价使用STARK的合成查询,这些查询构成了大部分基准.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
We use the public STaRK benchmark ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , whose data are released under CC BY 4.0. The code of STaRK, DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) , the Pi coding agent and ARK is released under the MIT License, and Codex CLI under the Apache License 2.0. Our research use of these artifacts is consistent with their licenses, and our derived data keep STaRK’s CC BY 4.0 license. The code, exported graphs, prompts and trajectories that we release are intended for research on agents that search knowledge graphs. STaRK’s queries are in English, as are almost all node records. The Amazon data contain user reviews, and the MAG data contain author names and affiliations. These public data are part of the benchmark. We use them as provided by STaRK, and all personal data in this work come from the benchmark. Because the agent can execute arbitrary shell commands, we ran it in a sandbox that keeps the graph files read-only and blocks access to the network and the labels (Appendix C ). We report point estimates from one evaluation per configuration and query set, with failed attempts retried as described in Appendix C . Appendix C gives the computational cost. The Amazon and Prime text-constraint tags in Appendix G were assigned by an LLM annotator, GPT-6-Luna.
We used AI assistants for coding and for writing assistance.

For Amazon, we use the default graph, which includes brand, category and color nodes. STaRK built these graphs from Amazon product reviews and metadata ( He and McAuley, 2016 ; McAuley et al., 2015 ) together with Amazon question-answer data ( McAuley and Yang, 2016 ) , from the Microsoft Academic Graph ( Sinha et al., 2015 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) through the OGB datasets ogbn-mag and ogbn-papers100M ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , and from PrimeKG ( Chandak et al., 2023 ) . Each exported graph consists of four parts.

blocks.en: Node files. Each node is stored as one JSON line with four fields: node_id (the benchmark ID, which is also the answer ID), node_type , is_candidate and attributes . The attributes field contains all source attributes of the node unchanged, except that non-finite numbers are written as null . Nodes are stored in ID order in shards of 10,000 nodes each ( nodes/NNNN.jsonl ).

blocks.en: Edge files. The edges of each relation type are stored in one tab-separated file, edges/RR.tsv , where RR is the relation-type ID. Each file has a header row ( source_id , target_id ) and one row for every edge stored in the benchmark’s edge index.
blocks.zh: 边缘文件. 每个关系类型的边缘被存储在一个分页文件中,边缘/RR.tsv,其中RR是关系类型的ID. 每个文件都有一个标题行(来源-id,目标-id)和一个行,每个边被存储在基准边索引上.

blocks.en: Schema and candidates. schema.json lists the dataset name, the node and candidate counts, the node and relation types, the number of stored rows per relation type, the shard size and short notes on the graph semantics. candidate_ids.txt lists the IDs that may be returned: products (Amazon), papers (MAG) and all nodes (Prime).

blocks.en: What the export preserves. The exported graphs keep all nodes, including the evidence nodes outside the candidate set (for example, brands in Amazon and authors in MAG), with all their attributes, every stored edge row and the type labels. The export is a plain-text copy of the released graph, with the node types, relation types and attribute fields of the release, and predictions are scored directly on the benchmark IDs. After exporting, the script checks that the node files contain every node exactly once and in ID order, and that 100 randomly chosen records per dataset read back identical to the source. Queries and gold answers are kept in files outside the agent’s sandbox. Table 4 gives the sizes of the exported graphs.

blocks.en: B.2 Prompt Validation
blocks.zh: B.2 迅速验证

blocks.en: All prompt decisions were made on STaRK validation queries with GPT-6-Luna in both harnesses, without using any test query, test trajectory or test label. A prompt-selection round compared ranking instructions and tool instructions. In its tool-instruction comparison on the same 450 queries (150 per dataset) for both prompts, the rg prompt reduced the share of shell commands that run Python from 47% to 5% with Codex and from 51% to 1.5% with Pi, relative to the prompt with the same ranking instruction and our tool instruction. With Codex, the share of queries in which the agent ran any Python fell from 98% to 12%. Input tokens rose by about 110k per query with both harnesses. We then revised the ranking instruction once, which produced the final prompt. On 750 further validation queries (300 from Amazon, 300 from MAG and 150 from Prime), we compared it with a base prompt whose ranking instruction allows up to 100 IDs and whose other text is the same. Overall R@20 rose from 61.9 to 71.3 with Pi and from 57.6 to 68.8 with Codex, and overall H@1 changed by − 2.3 -2.3 and − 0.8 -0.8 points, respectively. The prompt was fixed before any test result was seen.
blocks.zh: 所有关于STARK验证查询的快速决定都是在两个吊带上与GPT-6-Luna进行的,没有使用任何测试查询,测试轨迹或测试标签. 快速选择回合比较排名指示和工具指示. 在其对两个提示的450个相同的查询(每个数据集150个)进行工具指令比较时,rg 提示将运行 Python 的 shell 命令与 Codex 的比分从 47%降至 5%,与 Pi 的比分从 51%降至 1.5%,与运行同一排序指令和我们的工具指令的比分相对. 在 Codex 中,代理运行任何 Python 的查询份额从98%下降到12%. 输入符每查询一次上升约110克,同时使用两把吊带. 之后我们修改了一次排名指示,从而产生了最后的提示. 在750个进一步的验证询问(来自亚马逊的300个,来自MAG的300个,来自Prime的150个)中,我们把它与一个基础快件进行比较,其排名指示允许最多100个ID,其其他文本相同. 总体R@20与Pi从61.9上升至71.3,与Codex从57.6上升至68.8,总体H@1分别变化了-2.3-2.3和-0.8-0.8分. 在看到任何试验结果之前,即已固定了提示。

blocks.en: All runs of a configuration use the same harness, and each query has its own scratch directory. The agent writes its programs inline in its commands, and they are discarded after each query. All runs that we conducted, including the validation runs and the closed-book probes, used GPT-6-Luna or GPT-6-Astra through an API in September and October 2026.
blocks.zh: 一个配置的所有运行都使用相同的被子,每个查询都有自己的抓取目录. 代理在其命令中写入其程序,在每次查询后被丢弃. 2026年9月和10月,我们通过API进行的所有运行,包括验证运行和闭库探测器,都使用了GPT-6-Luna或GPT-6-Astra.

blocks.en: Pi. We use DCI-Agent-Lite ( Li et al., 2026 ) at upstream commit 271f37e (1 June 2026). DCI-Agent-Lite builds on the Pi coding agent ( Zechner and Pi Contributors, 2026 ) , 1 1 1 https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono using a fork of Pi version 0.65.0 to which it adds runtime context management. We use both as released. Our three small changes to DCI-Agent-Lite’s runner script are in our code release. The one that affects scoring reads the final answer from the last assistant message, so that an attempt that ends with a tool call or an error counts as failed. Pi runs in its offline mode with two tools, read and bash , and with its default system prompt, which lists the available tools and gives the date and the working directory. Its skills, prompt templates, themes and extensions are disabled, except for the extension that registers the graph tools. The model is GPT-6-Luna (GPT-6-Astra for the stronger-backbone rows) with reasoning effort high , a context window of 272,000 tokens and at most 32,000 output tokens per request. For context management, we use level 3 of DCI-Agent-Lite, the lightweight setting that it uses for its own benchmarks, which truncates large tool outputs and compacts the history by replacing older tool results with a placeholder. Each attempt may take at most 300 turns and 1,800 s of wall-clock time. Head-and-tail truncation, described below, is our one change to how Pi returns tool outputs.
blocks.zh: Pi. 我们在上游使用DCI-Agent-Lite(Li等,2026年)承诺271f37e(2026年6月1日)。 DCI- Agent- Lite 以 Pi 编码代理 (Zechner and Pi Controducers, 2026), 1 1 1 1 https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono. 使用Pi版本0.65.0的分叉,其中增加了运行时上下文管理. 我们使用两种释放。 我们对DCI-Agent-Lite的跑步脚本的三处小改动, 影响打分者从最后的助理消息读取最后的答案,这样以工具调用或出错结束的尝试就算作失败. Pi在离线模式下运行,有两个工具,读取和击出 并带有默认系统快取,其中列出了可用的工具并给出了日期和工作目录. 其技能,即时模板,主题和扩展被禁用,但注册图表工具的扩展除外. 该型号为GPT-6-Luna (GPT-6-Astra for the strong-backbone rains),推理努力高 . 上下文窗口为272,000个令牌,每个请求最多为32,000个输出令牌. 在上下文管理方面,我们使用DCI-Agent-Lite的第三级,即它用于自身基准的轻量级设置,通过用占位符取代更旧的工具结果来缩短大型工具输出并压缩历史. 每次尝试最多可能需要300个转弯和1 800秒的墙上时间。 如下所述,头尾节奏是我们对Pi如何返回工具输出的唯一改变。

blocks.en: Codex CLI. Full DKGI (Codex) runs the codex exec command of Codex CLI 0.156.1 2 2 2 https://github.com/openai/codex with the same model, reasoning effort and context window as Pi, and its budget is Pi’s time limit per attempt. User configuration, rules and project documents are ignored, sessions are ephemeral, and approval is never requested. Web search, network access and optional features such as multi-agent use, memory, plugins and browser use are disabled. Codex’s own system prompt and tool are used unchanged. With this tool, the model writes short JavaScript programs, each of which can run several shell commands in one call. Codex keeps its own output truncation, which lets the model raise the limit for an individual call, and we apply head-and-tail truncation in Pi.
blocks.zh: 代码CLI. Full DKGI (Codex) 运行 Codex CLI 0.156.1 2 2 2 https://github.com/openai/codex 的代码执行指令,其模式,推理努力和上下文窗口与 Pi 相同,其预算是 Pi 每一次尝试的时间限制. 用户配置,规则和项目文档被忽略,会话被麻痹,从未请求批准. 网页搜索,网络访问以及多代理使用,内存,插件和浏览器使用等可选功能被禁用. Codex 自己的系统即时和工具使用不变. 通过这个工具,模型会写出简短的JavaScript程序,每个程序可以在一个调用中运行多个 shell命令. Codex保留了自己的输出截取功能,这使得模型可以提高单个调取的极限,我们在Pi中应用了头尾截取功能.

blocks.en: Sandbox. Both harnesses run in the same outer sandbox, a deny-by-default Landlock policy under which system libraries, the harness code and the working directory are read-only. The working directory is the graph directory or, for the graph-tool variants, a directory that holds a single README file. The writable paths are an installation-ID file of Codex and the run directory of the query, which holds the scratch directory, the logs and a per-query home directory. In Pi, shell commands run in a second sandbox layer with a clean environment, a second Landlock policy and a seccomp filter that blocks network sockets. In Codex, they run in Codex’s own sandbox with network access disabled. Only the harness process itself connects to the model endpoint, and no variant has a web-search tool. Before the model is first called, a check inside the sandbox confirms that the working directory is read-only and that the query and label files, the original benchmark files and the user’s home configuration are unreadable. The scoring process reads the labels after the agent has finished.
blocks.zh: 沙发盒. 两把被套在同一个外沙盒中运行,这是一种逐一默认的Landlock政策,根据这项政策,系统库,被套用代码和工作目录只能被读取. 工作目录是图表目录,对于图表工具变体来说,是一个持有单个README文件的目录. 可写路径是Codex的安装-ID文件以及查询的运行目录,它持有抓取目录,日志和每克的家目录. 在 Pi 中, shell 命令在第二个沙盒层中运行,带有干净的环境,第二个 Landlock 政策和一个隔断网络套接字的分节过滤器. 在 Codex 中, 它们运行在 Codex 自己的沙盒中, 网络访问被禁用 。 只有牵引过程本身与模型端点相接,没有变体有网络搜索工具. 在模型被首次调用之前,沙盒内部的检查确认工作目录是只读取的,并且查询和标签文件,原始基准文件和用户的家庭配置是无法读取的. 评分过程在代理完成后读取标签.

blocks.en: Head-and-tail truncation. In every Pi variant with a shell, Pi’s bash tool runs its commands through a wrapper that implements the head-and-tail truncation of § 2.4 . The wrapper saves the complete output of every command in <scratch dir>/full_outputs/ , where the agent’s later commands can read it. An output of at most 18,000 bytes and 1,800 lines is returned as it is. For a longer output, the wrapper returns the first 9,000 bytes or 900 lines, whichever limit is reached first, then a notice on a separate line, and then the last 9,000 bytes or 900 lines. The notice reads: ⬇ [… harness output limit : showing the first < h > lines (< hb > bytes ) and the last < t > lines (< tb > bytes ) of < n > lines (< nb > bytes ); < ob > bytes omitted in between . Complete output saved to < path > - inspect it with rg , sed - n , head or tail . …] The command’s exit status is preserved. A truncated output stays below the 50 KB limit of Pi’s bash tool and the 20,000-character limit of DCI-Agent-Lite’s context management, so the model receives both of its ends together with the notice. The read tool keeps Pi’s limits (2,000 lines or 50 KB per call) and the 20,000-character limit of context management.
blocks.zh: 头尾相接. 在每一个带有外壳的 Pi 变体中, Pi 的bash 工具通过一个执行 第 2.4 节头尾截取的包装来运行其命令 。 包装器保存了 < scratch dir>/ full_outputs/ 中的每个命令的完整输出, 代理服务器的后继命令可以读取它 。 最多18 000字节和1 800行的输出按原样返回。 对于较长的输出,包装器会返回前9000字节或900行,以达到的限额为准,然后在单独的行上发出通知,再返回后9000字节或900行. 通知内容为: [. 取用输出限制: 显示 < h >行( < hb > 字节)和 < n >行( < tb > 字节)的上行( < nb > 字节); < ob > 字节之间省略。 完整输出保存到 < path > - 用 rg, sed - n, 头或尾巴检查. ] 命令的退出状态得以保留。 短线输出仍低于 Pi 的 Bash 工具的 50 KB 限制和 DCI - Agent - Lite 的上下文管理 的 2万 个字符限制,所以模型会同时收到通知的两端。 读取工具保留了Pi的极限(每通电话2,000行或50KB)和上下文管理的20,000个字符限制.

blocks.en:
Graph tools. Graph tools, Retrieval only and Graph tools + code access the graph through the tools in Table 5 . The tools are based on those of ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . The search and neighbors tools call ARK’s released implementations of its global search and one-hop neighborhood search, which run on ARK’s prepared graph (BM25 over ARK’s node names and summaries), and get_node and get_schema return a node record and the schema file of our graph export. The agent, the prompt and the step budget come from our harness. The tools are served by a process outside the sandbox, and the graph files also stay outside it.
In Graph tools and Retrieval only, the tools are registered in Pi as native function-calling tools with the descriptions in Table 5 , and Pi’s built-in tools are disabled, so every action of the agent is a graph-tool call. In Graph tools + code, the agent has Pi’s read and bash tools and calls the same four tools from Python through a client whose methods take the same arguments and return the same text. On the test subset, Graph tools + code made an average of 45.1 graph-tool calls per query within 6.8 bash calls, compared with 18.4 tool calls per query for Graph tools.
blocks.zh:
图表工具。 图表工具,只检索和图表工具+代码通过表5中的工具访问图表。 这些工具以ARK(Polonuer等,2026年)为基础。 搜索和邻里工具称ARK发布了其全球搜索和一跳相邻搜索的执行,这些搜索和邻里搜索运行在ARK准备的图表上(在ARK的节点名称和摘要之上的BM25),并获得_node并获得_schema返回一个节点记录和我们图表导出的计划文件. 代理, 即时和步骤预算来自我们的优势。 工具由沙盒外的流程服务,图文件也留在外.
在Graph 工具中,仅检索到,这些工具在 Pi 中注册为本地函数调用工具,其描述在表5中, Pi 的内置工具被禁用,因此代理器的每个动作都是用图表工具调用. 在 Graph 工具 + 代码中, 代理器拥有 Pi 的读取和击打工具, 通过一个客户端调用相同的 Python 四个工具, 其方法使用相同的参数并返回相同的文本 。 在测试子集上,Graph工具+代码在6.8个bash调用中平均每个查询进行45.1个phol-tool调用,而Graph工具每个查询进行18.4个调用.

blocks.en: Shell only. The shell can start a fixed list of 15 programs ( rg , cat , sed , head , tail , wc , cut , sort , comm , ls , find , pwd , xargs , echo and bash ). A Landlock execute rule enforces this list, also for find -exec and xargs . Before each query, a check confirms that these programs run and that starting python3 , awk , perl or node fails, testing python3 also through its absolute path, find -exec , xargs and the dynamic loader. Pipelines, bash loops, arrays and arithmetic remain available, and grep , awk and jq are unavailable. The graph directory is a hard-link copy of the graph export, and its DATA_FORMAT.txt omits the last line. Pi’s read tool and head-and-tail truncation are as in Full DKGI.
blocks.zh: 仅壳. 贝壳可以启动15个程序的固定列表(rg, cat, sed, head, 尾巴, wc, cut, s排序, com, Is, find , pwd, xargs, 回声和出击). 一个 Landlock 执行规则执行此列表, 也用于 find -exec and xargs 。 在每次查询之前,检查确认这些程序运行,并且启动 python3, awk, perl 或节点失败, 测试 python3 也通过它的绝对路径, 找到 -exec, xargs 和动态加载器. 管道、回路、阵列和算术仍然可用,而且没有grep、awk和jq。 图目录是图导出及其DATA_FORMAT的硬链接拷贝. txt 省略了最后一行内容。 Pi的读取工具和头尾截取与Full DKGI相同.

blocks.en: One program. The shell can start the 15 programs of Shell only under the same Landlock rules, as well as python3 , which has a budget of one start per attempt. The python3 command on the agent’s path is a launcher that requests each start from the process that runs the query, which keeps the count outside the sandbox. Every further start, including one from within the running program, is refused with exit status 126 and the fixed message python3: unavailable: Python 3 can be started only once in this task. A check before each query confirms this behavior, and the count is then reset. One program differs from Full DKGI in the single Python invocation, one added prompt line (Appendix B.1 ) and the programs that the shell can start, and is identical in all other respects. On the test subset, Full DKGI ran awk in 21 of its 5,866 shell commands, spread over 14 queries, and all its other interpreter runs were Python. With One program, 573 of the 710 queries used their single Python invocation.
blocks.zh: 一个程序。 外壳只能按照相同的"地克"规则来启动壳牌的15个程序,以及python3,它的预算是每次尝试一个开始. 代理行道上的python3命令是一个发射器,它要求从运行查询的过程开始,将计数保留在沙盒外. 每次进一步启动,包括运行程序内部的启动,都会被拒绝,退出状态为126,固定消息python3:不可用 : Python 3在此任务中只能启动一次. 每次查询前的检查都证实了这种行为,然后重新设置计数. 一个程序与单 Python 引用中的 Full DKGI 不同,一个程序增加了快行(Appendix B.1)以及 shell 可以启动的程序,在所有其他方面都是相同的. 在测试子集上,Full DKGI在它的5,866个 shell命令中,有21个运行了awk,分布在14个查询上,其所有其他的解释器运行都是Python. 通过一个程序,710个查询中有573个使用了他们的单Python引用.

blocks.en: No edges. The graph directory holds hard links to the node shards and to candidate_ids.txt , a schema.json from which the relation types, the edge counts and the note on graph semantics are removed, and a DATA_FORMAT.txt shortened by its four lines about edges. Node records are unchanged, so information that the source also stores as attribute text (for example, an Amazon product’s brand and category names) is still visible. Of the graph data, the sandboxes of Shell only and No edges can each read their own graph directory.
blocks.zh: 无有边际. 图表目录有与节点shards和候选站-ids.txt的硬链接,一个schema.json,从中去除关系类型,边缘计数和图表语义上的注释,以及一个DATA_FORMAT. txt被它关于边缘的四行所缩短. 节点记录没有变化,因此信息源也作为属性文本存储(例如亚马逊出品的品牌和类名)仍然可见. 在图表数据中,只有壳牌和无边相的沙盒可以各自读取自己的图表目录.

blocks.en: Scoring. The agent’s final message must be a JSON object with the single key node_ids and a list of at most 100 entries, and any other output counts as a failed attempt. Entries are scored in order, and an entry that is a non-integer, a non-candidate ID or a repeat keeps its position and counts as a miss. H@1 is 1 if the first entry is a gold answer. R@20 is the number of gold answers among the first 20 entries divided by the number of gold answers. MRR is the reciprocal rank of the first gold answer among the first 100 entries, and a list whose entries are all incorrect counts as a miss. Five runs on the test sets returned 21 IDs, one more than the 20 requested, and each of them has an incorrect answer at rank 21, so every reported MRR equals MRR over the first 20 entries. An attempt that ended in a provider error, at the time limit or with output other than the requested JSON was retried, and every query of a test configuration needed at most three attempts. Metrics are averaged over all queries of a set, and a query whose attempts all failed counts as a miss in every metric. In the test configurations, this occurred for one Amazon query of One program, whose three attempts all reached the time limit.
blocks.zh: 相会. 代理端的最终消息必须是带有单一密钥节点_ids的 JSON 对象,并列出最多100个条目,任何其他输出都算作失败尝试. 条目按顺序打入,一个非整数的条目,一个非指定身份的ID或重复保留其位置并算作出错. H@1是1,如果第一个条目是黄金答案. R@20是前20个条目中被金子解答数除以金子解答数的数字. MRR是前100个条目中第一个金子答案的对等分级,以及一个其条目全部不正确的列表算作漏取. 测试组的5个运行返回了21个ID,比请求的20个多出一个,每一个在21级有错误的答案,因此每个报告的MRR等于前20个条目的MRR. 以提供者出错而结束的尝试,在时间限度上或用所请求的JSON以外的输出,都经过了再试,每个测试配置的查询最多需要三次尝试. 在一个集合中的所有查询中均值度量,一个所有尝试失败的查询在每个度量中都算错. 在测试配置中,这是针对一个程序的一个亚马逊查询的,其三次尝试都达到了时限.

blocks.en: E.1 Trained or Tuned on STaRK
blocks.zh: E.1 在STARK接受训练或训练

blocks.en: AvaTaR ( Wu et al., 2024a ) is an LLM agent that scores candidate nodes with a Python program. The program is built from a library of predefined knowledge-base functions, which retrieve documents, embeddings and relations, compute similarity scores or ask an LLM to check a requirement. During optimization, a comparator LLM contrasts training queries on which the agent performs well with those on which it performs poorly and writes new instructions for the agent. The optimized program is applied directly to the test queries. We report its main results with Claude 3 Opus from Table 2 of the paper.
blocks.zh: AvaTAR(Wu等,2024a)是一个LLM代理,通过Python程序给候选节点评分. 程序由预定义的知识库函数库所构建,该库可以检索文档,嵌入和关系,计算相似分数或要求LLM检查一个需要. 在优化期间,比较方的LLM将代理商表现良好的培训查询与其表现不佳的查询进行比较,并为代理商写出新的指令. 优化后的程序被直接应用于测试查询. 我们从文件表2中向克洛德三世报告其主要结果。

blocks.en: PASemiQA ( Yang et al., 2025 ) separates planning from traversal. Its Llama 2-7B planner is fine-tuned to predict the shortest relation paths from the topic nodes of a query to its answers. A GPT-4 agent, guided by the predicted paths, takes actions that expand a node to its most relevant neighbors, retrieve nodes by embedding similarity and return the answer. We report its H@1 and MRR from Tables 2 and 10 of the paper.
blocks.zh: PASemiQA(Yang等,2025年)将规划与横道分开. 其Llama 2-7B计划器被微调,以预测从一个查询的主题节点到它的答案最短的关系路径. 一个GPT-4代理在预测路径的引导下,采取行动将一个节点扩展至其最相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相接相接相關相關相關相關相關相關相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 我们从文件表2和表10中报告H@1和MRR。

blocks.en: mFAR ( Li et al., 2025a ) is a trained retriever that represents each node by one field per property or relation. On MAG and Prime, these fields also include entities up to two hops away. mFAR scores every field with BM25 and a Contriever encoder and combines the scores with query-conditioned softmax weights. The encoder and the weights are trained on the STaRK training queries. The All+2 configuration scores both a single-document and a multi-field representation. We report it from Table 1 of the paper.
blocks.zh: mFAR(Li等,2025年a)是训练有素的取回器,每个取出一个地段或关系代表每个节点. 在MAG和Prime上,这些字段还包括最多2个跳出的实体. mFAR用 BM25 和一个 Contriever 编码器对每个字段进行分数,并将分数与有查询条件的软马克斯分数合并. 编码器和分量都接受了STARK训练查询的培训. All+2配置既得分单文件分,又得分多场代表. 我们从文件表1上报告。

blocks.en: MoR ( Lei et al., 2025 ) mixes structural and textual retrieval. A Llama 3.2-3B planner, fine-tuned on 1,000 sampled training queries with LLM-generated planning graphs, outlines the entities that a query involves and the relations between them. A layer-wise traversal follows this plan and at each layer merges the neighbors of the planned node type with textual matches, which come from BM25 on Amazon and MAG and from a fine-tuned Contriever on Prime. A trained reranker then scores each candidate from features of the trajectory that reached it (the node types along the path, whether each step was structural or textual and the text similarity of each node) and from the candidate’s ada-002 similarity to the query. We report the MoR row from Table 1 of the paper.
blocks.zh: MoR (Lei等, 2025.)混合了结构和文字检索. 一名Llama 3.2-3B规划师用LLM生成的规划图对1 000个抽样培训查询进行了微调,概述了查询所涉及的实体及其之间的关系。 一个分层的转盘遵循了这个计划,并且在每个分层将计划中的节点类型的相邻点与文字匹配点合并,它们来自亚马逊和MAG上的BM25和Prime上的微调Contriever. 一个训练有素的重新排名者然后从到达的轨迹特征(沿着路径的节点类型,每个步骤是结构的还是文字的,以及每个节点的文字相似性)和候选人的ada-002与查询的相似性对每个候选人进行评分。 我们从文件表1上报告MOR行.

blocks.en: GraphRAFT ( Clemedtson and Shi, 2025 ) stores the KG in a Neo4j graph database and retrieves answers in three stages. GPT-4o-mini identifies the entities in the query, and a name without an exact match is resolved to its most similar nodes through a vector index over ada-002 node embeddings. A text-to-Cypher model then generates Cypher queries whose decoding is restricted to the schema-valid multi-hop queries around the identified entities, and the most probable queries are executed until the retrieved subgraph reaches a size limit. A Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct model then reads the textualized subgraph and selects and orders the answers. The text-to-Cypher model starts from Neo4j’s Gemma 2-9B text2cypher checkpoint, and both models are fine-tuned with LoRA on MAG and Prime. We report the full system from Table 1 of the paper, which covers these two datasets.
blocks.zh: 图表 (Clemedtson and Shi,2025)将KG存储于Neo4j图数据库并分三个阶段检索答案. GPT-4o-mini识别出查询中的实体,一个没有精确匹配的名称通过ada-002节点嵌入的矢量索引解决到最相近的节点. 文本到Cypher模型然后生成Cypher查询,其解码被限制在被识别实体周围的schema-valid多跳查询,最可能的查询被执行,直到被检索到的子图达到大小限制. 一个Llama 3.1-8B-指令模型然后读取文字化的子图并选择和命令答案. 文本到Cypher模型起自Neo4j的Gemma 2-9B文本2crypher检查站,两个模型在MAG和Prime上与LORA进行了微调. 我们从文件表1中报告整个系统,其中涵盖这两个数据集。

blocks.en: GRASP ( Tao et al., 2026 ) is a three-stage retrieval pipeline. A prompted Qwen3-27B-Instruct planner writes a JSON plan of anchors, hops and a target, which is compiled into one Cypher query on Neo4j. The resulting candidates are rescored with Qwen3-Embedding-4B on Amazon and MAG and with SapBERT on Prime. Their ranking is then fused with that of a trained mFAR retriever under a weight that can depend on the plan. Finally, a Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B, fine-tuned with LoRA on the STaRK training queries, reranks the top 100 candidates of the fused ranking, and its output is fused with that ranking once more. The fusion weights are tuned on the validation queries, and the Prime planner prompt contains 19 STaRK training queries with hand-curated plans. We report the full system, listed as supervised GRASP in Table 1 of the paper.
blocks.zh: GRASP (Tao等, 2026)是一个三级取回管. 一个被激发的Quen3-27B-Instruct计划员写出由主播,hops和一个目标组成的JSON计划,这个计划被编译为Neo4j上的一个Cypher查询. 由此产生的候选人在亚马逊和MAG上与Qune3-Embedding-4B和Prime上与SapBERT重分. 他们的排名随后与训练有素的mFAR取回器的排名相融合,其重量取决于计划. 最后,一款与LORA在STARK训练查询上进行微调的Quen3-Rranker-0.6B重新排名了被保险人排名前100名的候选人,其产出再次与该排名相接. 聚变权重被调用到验证查询上,Prime planners即刻包含有19个STARK训练查询,并附有手测计划. 我们报告整个系统,在文件表1中被列为受监督的巨猿生存方案。

blocks.en: E.2 Training-Free
blocks.zh: E.2 免费培训

blocks.en: BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) , ColBERTv2 ( Santhanam et al., 2022 ) and GritLM-7B ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) are lexical, late-interaction and LLM-based embedding retrievers that Wu et al. (2024b) evaluate on the candidate node documents of each KG. BM25 scores a document by the frequency of the query terms in it, adjusted for term rarity and document length, and ColBERTv2 matches token-level embeddings of the query against those of each document. GritLM-7B embeds the query and the documents with a 7B LLM trained for both embedding and generation and ranks the documents by similarity. We report their results on the full test sets from Table 6 of the STaRK paper.
blocks.zh: BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009), ColBERTv2(Santhanam等, 2022年)和GritLM-7B (Muennighoff等, 2025年)是词汇学,后期交互和基于LLM的嵌入检索器,由Wu等(2024年b)在每个KG的候选节点文件中评价. BM25按其查询术语的频率对一文档进行分数,并按术语稀有度和文档长度进行调整,而ColBERTv2则将查询的符号级嵌入与每个文档的符号级相匹配. GritLM-7B将查询和文件嵌入一个7B LLM训练,用于嵌入和生成,并按相似性排列文档. 我们从STARK文件表6上 报告测试结果

blocks.en: KAR ( Xia et al., 2025b ) expands the query with an LLM before dense retrieval. It retrieves the documents of the entities mentioned in the query and collects their neighbors up to two hops away. For each entity, it keeps the ten neighbors whose documents are most similar to the query. GPT-4o writes query expansions from the resulting document triples, and ada-002 embeddings match the expanded query against the node documents. We report this configuration from Table 2 of the paper.
blocks.zh: KAR (Xia等, 2025b.)在密集检索前用LLM来扩展查询. 它取回查询中提到的实体的文件,并收集邻居最多2次。 对每个实体来说,它保留了10个邻居,这些邻居的文档与查询最相类似. GPT-4o从产生的文档三进制中写出查询扩展,而ada-002嵌入与节点文档相匹配的扩展查询. 我们从文件表2中报告这一配置。

blocks.en: HybGRAG ( Lee et al., 2025 ) is an LLM agent that routes each query to a text retriever or a hybrid retriever and refines the routing with a critic. An LLM router identifies the topic entities and the relevant relations. The hybrid retriever then follows these relations within the ego-graphs of the entities and ranks the documents it reaches by vector similarity to the query. An LLM validator checks the top results, and an LLM commenter returns corrective feedback to the router for at most four iterations. The examples in its prompts come from the STaRK training set. We report its main configuration with Claude 3 Sonnet and ada-002 embeddings from Table 5 of the paper, which covers MAG and Prime.
blocks.zh: HybGRAG(Lee等,2025年)是一种LLM代理,它将每个查询都通向文本检索器或混合检索器,并用评论员来细化路由. 一个LLM路由器可以识别主题实体和相关关系. 混合检索器然后在实体的自负图中跟踪这些关系,并通过与查询的矢量相似来排列其到达的文档. 一个LLM验证器检查了顶端结果,一个LLM评论器将纠正反馈返回到路由器中,最多进行四个迭代. 其提示中的例子来自STARK训练集. 我们报告它的主要配置是Claude 3 Sonnet和从文件表5中嵌入的ada-002,该表涵盖MAG和Prime。

blocks.en: AF-Retriever ( Boer et al., 2026 ) is an eight-step LLM pipeline that combines graph constraints with vector similarity search. The LLM writes a Cypher query. On Prime, where answers can have several node types, it first predicts the target node type. The query is parsed into relational triples and attribute constraints, which are grounded on the graph by embedding search and set intersection. Vector search fills about two thirds of the 20 final candidates from the grounded set and the rest from unconstrained candidates of the target type, and the LLM reranks these 20 pairwise. We report its zero-shot configuration with gpt-oss-120B and text-embedding-3-small. Its H@1 and MRR come from Table 3 of the paper, and its R@20 comes from the complete-pipeline row of the ablation table (Table 5).
blocks.zh: AF-Retriever(Boer等,2026年)是一款将图约束与向量相似性搜索相结合的八步LLM管. LLM 写一个 Cypher 查询 。 在Prime上,在答案可以有多个节点类型的地方,它首先预测目标节点类型. 查询被解为关系三重和属性限制,这些限制通过嵌入搜索和设置相接点来以图表为基础. 矢量搜索填补了被禁足的组合中20名最终候选人的约三分之二,其余则填补了目标类型的未受约束候选人的三分之二,而LLM则将这20名对等排名重新排列. 我们用gpt-oss-120B和文字-嵌入-3-小来报告它的零镜头配置. 其H@1和MRR来自论文的表3,而其R@20来自通缩表的完整管线行(表5)。

blocks.en: ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) is an LLM agent that calls two predefined tools. A global search ranks node texts with BM25, and a one-hop neighborhood search can filter the neighbors of a node by node and edge type and rank them by a subquery. Three agents run in parallel for at most 20 steps each, and the nodes they select are fused by vote count. We report its GPT-5.2 results from Table 5 in the appendix of the paper. Our graph tools call ARK’s implementations of these two tools (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: ARK(Polonuer等,2026年-)是一种LLM剂,可调用两个预定义的工具. 全球搜索以 BM25 排序为节点文本,一跳相邻搜索可以通过节点和边缘类型来过滤节点的邻居,并用子克来排序. 3名特工平行运行,每名最多20步,他们选择的节点通过计票方式被接通. 我们报告该文件附录表5的GPT-5.2结果。 我们的图表工具称为ARK对这两个工具(附录C)的落实.

blocks.en: E.3 KG Reasoning Methods Adapted to STaRK
blocks.zh: E.3 KG 适应STARK的理性方法

blocks.en: Yang et al. (2025) adapt three KG reasoning methods to STaRK and run them with GPT-4. We report their H@1 and MRR from Tables 2 and 10 of that paper.
blocks.zh: Yang等 (2025) 将三种KG推理方法与STARK相适应并用GPT-4运行. 我们从该文件表2和表10中报告他们的H@1和MRR。

blocks.en: ToG ( Sun et al., 2024 ) runs an LLM-guided beam search on the KG that alternates relation and entity exploration and stops once the LLM judges the retained reasoning paths sufficient or the search reaches a maximum depth.
blocks.zh: ToG(Sun等,2024年)对KG进行LLM制导光束搜索,在LLM判断保留推理路径足够或搜索达到最大深度后,替换关系和实体探索并停止.

blocks.en: RoG ( Luo et al., 2024b ) generates relation paths grounded in the KG as plans, retrieves the reasoning paths that follow these plans and lets the LLM reason over them. In its original form, RoG’s planner is Llama 2-Chat-7B instruction-tuned on WebQSP and CWQ ( Yih et al., 2016 ; Talmor and Berant, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: RoG(Luo等,2024b)将基于KG的关联路径作为计划产生,取回遵循这些计划的推理路径,让LLM理性凌驾于这些路径之上. RoG的原型规划者为Llama 2-Chat-7B discult-turned on WebQSP和CWQ(Yih等,2016;Talmor和Berant,2018).

blocks.en: GoG ( Xu et al., 2024 ) is a training-free KG agent that interleaves thinking, searching and generation steps, in which the LLM proposes new triples from its own knowledge and verifies them.
blocks.zh: GOG(Xu等,2024年)是一款无培训的KG代理,该代理互通了思考,搜索和生成步骤,其中LLM从自己的知识中提出出新的三相并验证.

blocks.en: Appendix F Closed-Book Probes
blocks.zh: 附录F 闭库检测

blocks.en: The closed-book probes measure how many queries the model answers from its parametric knowledge alone (§ 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 封闭式书本探测器仅从其参数学知识中衡量了多少次查询模型答案(§3.3.

blocks.en: Design. Both probes run GPT-6-Luna in Pi with reasoning effort high , and the model answers in a single closed-book turn (prompts in Appendix B ). The ID probe asks for up to 20 STaRK node IDs, ranked by confidence, and is run on the full test sets of all three datasets (7,108 queries). Since node IDs are arbitrary integers, a correct ID could indicate that the model has memorized benchmark files. The name probe asks for up to 20 answer names (exact paper titles for MAG and exact PrimeKG entity names for Prime), which we map to node IDs offline. Because Amazon product titles are long and rarely match exactly, it is run on the full MAG and Prime test sets (5,466 queries). The 12,574 probe runs cost $8.31 in total, and the 4 runs that failed count as wrong.
blocks.zh: 设计. 两种探测器在Pi运行了GPT-6-Luna,其推理努力高,而模型在单闭页转弯(附录B中的瞬间)中解答. ID探测器要求最多20个STARK节点ID,按置信排序,运行在全部三个数据集的全测试集上(7,108个查询). 由于节点ID是任意的整数,正确的ID可以表明模型已经记住了基准文件. 名称探测器要求最多20个答案名称(MAG精确的纸张标题和Prime的精确PrimeKG实体名称),我们将其映射到节点ID下线. 由于亚马逊产品标题很长,很少准确匹配,因此它运行在全MAG和Prime测试集上(5,466个查询). 12,574号探测器总共运行了8.31美元,失败的4个运行计为错误.

blocks.en: Name mapping. The mapping uses the exported node files. MAG papers are indexed under their title and OriginalTitle , and Prime nodes under their name , details.name and every entry of details.alias . After the same normalization of indexed and returned names (NFKC, case folding, non-alphanumeric characters replaced with spaces), a returned name maps to every node indexed under the same normalized name. A query counts as answered at rank r r if the r r -th returned name maps to at least one gold node.
blocks.zh: 名称映射. 映射使用导出节点文件 。 MAG的论文以标题和原文标出索引,而Prime节点以它们的名字标出细节。 名字和每条细节 别名. 在索引和回取名称(NFKC,大小写折叠,用空格取而代之的非缩写字符)的相同正常化后,一个返回的名称映射到在同一种正常化名称下索引的每个节点. 如果 r -th 将名称地图返回到至少一个黄金节点, 查询数以 r 等分数计 。

blocks.en: Results. The ID probe answers 0 of 1,642 Amazon, 0 of 2,665 MAG and 1 of 2,801 Prime queries correctly (H@1 of 0.00, 0.00 and 0.04%). Among all returned IDs (up to 20 per query), a gold ID appears for 1 Amazon and 4 Prime queries. The name probe obtains an H@1 of 2.3% on MAG (61 of 2,665) and 20.9% on Prime (585 of 2,801). Table 8 splits the queries by whether the name probe answers them. On the queries that the name probe answers incorrectly, Full DKGI achieves an H@1 of 88.4 on MAG and 56.9 on Prime. On the 223 Prime queries of the test subset that the name probe answers incorrectly, the variants with access to the relations achieve between 55.6 and 63.2, while Retrieval only and No edges achieve 28.7 and 28.3, respectively.
blocks.zh: 结果。 ID探测器对1,642个亚马逊的0个,2,665个MAG的0个和2,801个Prime查询中的1个正确回答(H@1为0.00,0.00和0.04%). 在所有返回的ID(每个查询最多20个)中,1个亚马逊和4个Prime查询都出现了金色的ID. 名称探测器在MAG上获得H@1,为2.3%(2 665人中的61人),在Prime上获得20.9%(2 801人中的585人). 表8按名称探测器是否回答它们来划分询问. 在名称探测器不正确回答的询问上,Full DKGI在MAG上实现了H@1的88.4,在Prime上实现了56.9. 在名称探针错误回答的测试子集的223个主质询问上,访问关系的变体分别实现55.6到63.2,而仅检索和无边分别实现28.7和28.3.
